selected_leaf: Derive the minimal target-authoritative freshness/order witness and comparison rule needed to distinguish genuinely newer verifier evidence from stale or replayed target observations, and prove stale target evidence cannot regress protocol checkpoints or authorize a second logical effect.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract recurring-Chat Stage T protocols preserving one immutable logical_effect_id and exact (T,w,d), with role-local CAS checkpoint state and a target-authoritative verifier. No concrete product or API is claimed to expose the required witness.

minimal_witness.A: target-authority domain identity that prevents order tokens from different target authorities from being compared
minimal_witness.g: target generation/epoch identity under which the monotonic sequence is defined; generation rollover is comparable only with target-authoritative successor proof
minimal_witness.e: immutable evidence identity/digest bound by the target verifier to exact (T,w,d), verdict, A, g and n; equal order positions with unequal evidence are equivocation, not freshness
minimality_argument: Without A, a token from another authority domain can be misordered as local evidence.
Without g or an equivalent reset-domain identity, a counter reset can make newer evidence look stale or stale evidence look newer.
Without n or an equivalent target-authoritative monotonic order relation, replay cannot be distinguished from genuine supersession.
Without immutable exact-scope evidence identity e, same-position replay/equivocation or verdict substitution cannot be detected.
Wall-clock time, local retry count, transport acknowledgement and repository commit time are not substitutes because none proves target-authoritative order.

comparison_rule: First require exact verifier binding to the same logical_effect_id,T,w,d and authority domain A. A mismatch is INCOMPARABLE_UNSAFE.
Within the same (A,g), q2 is strictly newer than q1 iff n2>n1 and both evidence bindings verify.
Within the same (A,g,n), identical e is replay/same evidence; unequal e or unequal verdict is EQUIVOCATION_UNSAFE and never authorizes mutation.

Across generations, q2 may be treated as newer only when target-authoritative evidence proves g2 is a successor of g1 for the same authority domain without an ambiguous reset. Otherwise the observations are INCOMPARABLE_UNSAFE.
A target observation lacking a verifiable q is unresolved evidence, never proof of absence, conflict, commit, freshness or retry permission.
checkpoint_reconciliation_rule: ATTEMPT_ARMED and VERIFY_PENDING are crash-conservative: stale, replayed, equal, unverifiable or incomparable target evidence cannot regress them to VERIFY_BEFORE_ATTEMPT and cannot rotate w or logical_effect_id.
COMMITTED and CONFLICT are locally terminal and monotonic against stale/replayed/nonterminal observations. A strictly newer consistent terminal observation may strengthen evidence only.
A strictly newer contradictory terminal observation against a local terminal classification yields UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE with both evidence identities preserved; it does not reopen mutation.
A strictly newer exact-scope COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT may terminally resolve a nonterminal checkpoint before any future mutation decision.
Reconciliation itself always sets mutation_permitted=false; any later protocol action must begin from the reconciled durable checkpoint on a later bounded step.
stale_evidence_non_regression_proof: The only order relation admitted is target-authoritative strict freshness under the same comparable authority/generation domain. Stale, replayed, equal or incomparable observations therefore cannot satisfy the premise of any state-advancing target-evidence rule.
All non-strictly-new observations leave ATTEMPT_ARMED/VERIFY_PENDING crash-conservative and leave COMMITTED/CONFLICT terminal; no transition points back to a mutation-capable pre-attempt state.
Witness identity (logical_effect_id,T,w,d) is immutable and q never creates or rotates w, so target evidence cannot synthesize a second logical effect identity.
Reconciliation performs no target mutation and explicitly sets mutation_permitted=false. Contradiction or equivocation fails closed as UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE.
Thus, within the tested abstract scope, stale/replayed target evidence cannot regress ATTEMPT_ARMED, VERIFY_PENDING, COMMITTED or CONFLICT and cannot authorize a second logical effect.
unresolved_conditions: A concrete target must expose A,g,n,e or a semantically equivalent target-authoritative immutable ordering witness with reset/successor semantics.
A concrete verifier must prove exact binding of evidence to logical_effect_id,T,w,d and verdict.

The next proof obligation is to derive a bounded verifier-consumption state machine that stores q_last in the role-local checkpoint and proves exactly-once consumption of strictly newer terminal evidence across checkpoint CAS races.
